concept: Anticipating second-order effects of a decision before making it
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic decision (business, financial, family) with an appealing immediate effect and a less obvious second-order consequence
exercise.reflection_prompt: What happens after the first, obvious effect plays out?
exercise.practice: Adult traces at least one second-order effect before deciding

assessment.success_marker: adult identifies a genuine second-order effect, not just a restatement of the first-order one
